</a>

            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="deepseek-v4--claude-code-thinking-mode-400-错误修复方案">DeepSeek V4 + Claude Code thinking mode 400 错误修复方案</h1>
<h2 id="问题描述">问题描述</h2>
<p>使用 DeepSeek V4 Pro / V4 Flash 的 thinking mode + tool calls 时，第一轮工具调用后的每次请求都返回 <strong>400 错误</strong>：</p>
<pre><code>API Error: 400 The `content[].thinking` in the thinking mode must be passed back to the API.
</code></pre>
<h2 id="根因">根因</h2>
<pre><code>Claude Code  →  DeepSeek API（返回 reasoning_content / thinking 块）
                ↓
Claude Code 保存对话历史时丢弃非标准的 thinking 字段
                ↓
下一轮请求 → DeepSeek API：检测到 assistant 消息缺少 thinking 块 → 400
</code></pre>
<p>DeepSeek V4 要求 multi-turn 对话中，每个 <code>role: assistant</code> 的消息必须保留 thinking 块。Claude Code / cc-switch 在序列化历史时把它丢弃了。</p>
<h2 id="解决方案">解决方案</h2>
<p>在 Claude Code 和 DeepSeek API 之间插入一个本地 Node.js 代理，自动补全被丢弃的 thinking 字段。</p>
<h3 id="拓扑">拓扑</h3>
<pre><code>Claude Code → cc-switch → 本地代理 (127.0.0.1:15722) → api.deepseek.com
                               ↑
                        注入 thinking 块
</code></pre>
<h2 id="步骤">步骤</h2>
<h3 id="1-创建代理脚本-ds-proxyjs">1. 创建代理脚本 <code>ds-proxy.js</code></h3>
<pre><code class="language-js">const http = require('http');
const { Readable } = require('stream');

const DEEPSEEK_BASE = 'https://api.deepseek.com';
const PORT = 15722;

function fixMessages(data) {
    if (!data.messages &amp;&amp; !Array.isArray(data.messages)) return;
    for (const msg of data.messages) {
        if (msg.role !== 'assistant') continue;
        if (Array.isArray(msg.content)) {
            const hasThinking = msg.content.some(b =&gt; b.type === 'thinking');
            if (!hasThinking) {
                msg.content.unshift({ type: 'thinking', thinking: '' });
            }
        } else {
            msg.reasoning_content = msg.reasoning_content || '';
        }
    }
}

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) =&gt; {
    console.log(`${req.method} ${req.url}`);
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');

    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
        res.writeHead(204);
        res.end();
        return;
    }

    if (req.method === 'GET') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
        res.end(JSON.stringify({ id: 'root', object: 'list' }));
        return;
    }

    if (req.method !== 'POST') {
        res.writeHead(404);
        res.end('Not Found');
        return;
    }

    let body = '';
    req.on('data', chunk =&gt; body += chunk);
    req.on('end', async () =&gt; {
        try {
            const data = JSON.parse(body);
            fixMessages(data);

            const target = DEEPSEEK_BASE + req.url;
            console.log('-&gt;', target);

            const apiRes = await fetch(target, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Authorization': req.headers.authorization,
                    'anthropic-version': req.headers['anthropic-version'] || ''
                },
                body: JSON.stringify(data)
            });

            console.log('&lt;-', apiRes.status);
            const headers = {};
            apiRes.headers.forEach((v, k) =&gt; { headers[k] = v; });
            res.writeHead(apiRes.status, headers);

            if (apiRes.body) {
                Readable.fromWeb(apiRes.body).pipe(res);
            } else {
                res.end();
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Proxy error:', err.message);
            res.writeHead(500);
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Proxy Error: ' + err.message }));
        }
    });
});

server.listen(PORT, () =&gt; {
    console.log('DS4 Proxy on http://127.0.0.1:' + PORT);
});
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-启动代理">2. 启动代理</h3>
<pre><code class="language-powershell">node ds-proxy.js
</code></pre>
<p>保持在后台运行。</p>
<h3 id="3-配置-cc-switch">3. 配置 cc-switch</h3>
<p>DeepSeek provider 的 Base URL 设为：</p>
<pre><code>http://127.0.0.1:15722/anthropic
</code></pre>
<p>或跳过 cc-switch，直连代理：</p>
<pre><code class="language-powershell">$env:ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:15722/anthropic"
$env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "你的DeepSeek API Key"
claude
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-重启-claude-code">4. 重启 Claude Code</h3>
<h2 id="代理处理逻辑">代理处理逻辑</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>场景</th>
<th>操作</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Anthropic 格式（content 为数组）</td>
<td>在 content 最前面插入 <code>{type:"thinking",thinking:""}</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>OpenAI 格式</td>
<td>注入 <code>reasoning_content: ""</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>连通性检测（GET）</td>
<td>返回 <code>{"id":"root","object":"list"}</code> 模拟 API</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

</ul>
